name: hwinfo
description: Comprehensive hardware analysis, monitoring and reporting tool for Windows systems

hwinfo64.description: Hardware information and monitoring tool for detailed system analysis
hwinfo64.usage:
hwinfo64.exe # Launch GUI interface
hwinfo64.exe /logfile="system_report.txt" # Generate detailed system report
hwinfo64.exe /hidelog # Run with hidden logging
hwinfo64.exe /sensors-only # Launch sensors-only monitoring
hwinfo64.exe /shared-mem # Enable shared memory interface for third-party tools
hwinfo64.exe /minimal # Launch in minimal interface mode
